title: Total spent per customer with zero for no orders
prompt: Return every customer's name (as name) along with their total amount spent (as total_spent). Include customers who have never placed an order, showing 0 instead of NULL for their total_spent.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust9 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust9 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'),(4,'Dave'); CREATE TABLE ord9 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO ord9 VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,1,30.0),(3,2,20.0);
reference_sql: SELECT cust9.name, COALESCE(SUM(ord9.amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM cust9 LEFT JOIN ord9 ON cust9.id = ord9.customer_id GROUP BY cust9.id, cust9.name;
